test.name: Both opening-turn questions answered together need no follow-up
test.description: Single-turn decomposition extended to both opening-turn questions at once: the user states the research objective and experience level in the first message, so nothing needs asking or defaulting. Tests that init-project recognizes both from one message and completes in a single pass with no unnecessary questions. Site access is no longer asked, so `subscriptions` must be left absent.

input.user_message: init-project: Start a new project for FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF. I want to identify his parents. About me: I'm experienced.

judge_context: The stored objective should reflect 'identify his parents' -- a specific, user-stated objective, not the generic default.

`researcher_profile.narration_guidance` should be the verbatim experienced-level text: 'No preambles. Do the work and report results concisely. Assume fluency with GPS and standard genealogy terminology.'
Neither default (generic objective, `intermediate`) should be used or mentioned as assumed, since the user answered both in the opening message.
Should create both research.json and tree.gedcomx.json in this single pass, seeding the Patrick Flynn stub from person-read-flynn.
Should not re-ask either question -- they were all already answered.
`researcher_profile.subscriptions` should be **absent** — site access is no longer asked, and the field is left unwritten rather than defaulted.
